Belay 2.1.1

  • Lid Hold works again after an update. The system kept a stale record of Belay's lid helper after the 2.1.0 update and refused every request to it, so holding through a closed lid silently did nothing. Belay now refreshes the registration at every launch and again if the helper stops answering.
  • Nudge no longer reports a finished session as gone quiet. A /compact after a Stop, a parked session's trailing writes, a session that stopped and expired in the same moment, and a Stop with background tasks past its budget all used to sound as a session that went quiet.

Belay 2.1.0

  • Auto Allow in Codex. Clicks "Allow once" in the ChatGPT desktop app too, using the same rules for local sites. Works when Codex is enabled in Settings › Agents.
  • Nudge, a new module. Plays a sound when an agent finishes, needs you, or goes quiet, and reminds you if it's still waiting. Click a notification to bring its app to the front.
  • Orphan Watch, a new module. Shows processes left running after a session ends and high CPU use while an agent is idle. End asks a process to quit after you confirm. Never reads command lines or file contents.
  • Auto Allow returns you to your previous app after checking a background session, unless you've started using your Mac.
  • With Precise Detection on, Auto Allow no longer opens background Claude sessions unnecessarily after a turn ends.
  • Precise Detection works with ChatGPT 26.928's bundled Codex again. If setup failed after that ChatGPT update, turn Codex off and on in Settings › Agents after updating Belay.
  • Modules are easier to scan, with distinct colors, shorter summaries, and icons that animate on hover.
  • Auto Allow no longer mistakes embedded web pages in Claude or Codex for permission requests.

Auto Allow requires Accessibility access.

Belay 2.0.0

  • Modules. Optional tools in Settings. Each stays off until you install it. No downloads needed.
  • Screenshot Cleaner. Automatically moves older screenshots to the Trash. You choose how long to keep them.
  • Warm Microphone. Keeps the microphone active so dictation catches your first word. No audio is recorded, stored, or sent.
  • Auto Allow. Clicks "Allow once" in Claude to approve requests for local sites. Turns off automatically after the time you set.

Auto Allow requires Accessibility access. macOS asks for microphone access when you first turn on Warm Microphone.

Belay 1.8.1

  • Night dimming stops flickering. Belay now waits 30 seconds after another app releases the display before dimming it, so videos and other apps that renew their hold no longer make the screen blink.

Belay 1.8.0

  • See stats for each project. Double-click a session in Statistics to see agent time, sessions, tokens and recent runs for that folder.
  • Background tasks hold more reliably. Late or duplicate hook events no longer end a hold early or restart one after release.
  • Hooks recover after an interrupted quit. If Belay is killed while closing, it restores its agent settings on the next launch.
  • The diagnostics log stays small. Once it passes 3 MB, Belay trims it back to the most recent 1 MB.

Also: Sessions now keeps the latest 100 runs, and its headline shows total agent time instead of the number of rows.
